eplus.description.minecraft.bane_of_arth: Extra damage to spiders, cave spiders and silverfish
eplus.description.minecraft.blast_protec: Protection against explosion damage; reduces explosion recoil
eplus.description.minecraft.efficiency: Faster resource gathering while in use
eplus.description.minecraft.fire_protect: Protection against fire damage; fire is extinguished faster
eplus.description.minecraft.fortune: Increases the drop rate of items from blocks
eplus.description.minecraft.projectile_p: Protection against damage from projectile entities
eplus.description.minecraft.respiration: Decreases the rate of air loss underwater; increases time between damage while suffocating and drowning
eplus.description.minecraft.silk_touch: Mined blocks will drop themselves instead of the item(s) it should drop
eplus.description.minecraft.thorns: Chance of dealing damage to mobs or players attacking the wearer
jei.eplus.enchanting_table: Enchanting Plus: right-click the enchanting table, put in a tool, armour or book and drag the slider of each enchantment to the level you want. "E" enchants for the shown cost in experience levels. Bookshelves (two blocks away, both heights, air in between) raise the highest possible cost. Enchantments added on the table can be taken back for levels. "R" repairs an enchanted, damaged item with the levels you have. "Vanilla" and "Mod" switch between this and the vanilla table. /eplus useMod false keeps the vanilla table.
